notes: Verifier 2026-11-15: the homepage returned only a verification screen; read the meet the farmers, CSA, pick-up locations and half beef pages. The farmers describe grass-fed, grass-finished beef and pastured chickens, turkeys and eggs, and the beef product pages say pasture raised 100% grass-fed and finished. Quarter, half and whole beef can be reserved online with a down payment. A three-month monthly meat CSA (beef, chicken, optional pork, egg add-on) is offered. The pick-up locations page lists a monthly drop at 120 North Rose Street, Palatine (second Saturday 10:30 a.m.) and in-person sales at Healthy Harvest Urban Gardens, Rock Island; the CSA page names older pickup towns (Elgin, Downers Grove, Arlington Heights, Bloomington, Peoria), which were not recorded. Pork is listed from the CSA page only; its feed is not described. The site says it is organically certified; organic labels are left to the USDA matching script.
